config.cataclysm_dimension.title: Cataclysm Dimension Settings
config.cataclysm_dimension.hint: Hover over an option for its purpose and when it takes effect.
config.cataclysm_dimension.server_note: Server-owned settings; remote servers must edit their own config.
config.cataclysm_dimension.save_failed: Save failed. Check the log; no changes were applied.
config.cataclysm_dimension.effect.live: Takes effect after saving on the local server. Already queued operations may finish; existing entities and effects are not undone.
config.cataclysm_dimension.effect.worldg: Restart the game/server. Only newly generated chunks use the new placement; existing structures remain. Use a new world for a consistent layout.
config.cataclysm_dimension.effect.restar: Restart the game/server and reopen the world. No new world is required; existing saved respawn points are not cleared.
config.cataclysm_dimension.effect.next_l: Starts after the next world load/server start. Works in existing worlds; no new world is required.
config.cataclysm_dimension.enable_telepo: Sneak and use the corresponding eye to enter its arena dimension. A loading message appears while the destination is prepared.
config.cataclysm_dimension.keep_structur: Also allow Cataclysm structures in their original dimensions instead of only in dedicated arena dimensions.
config.cataclysm_dimension.random_spread: Use random-spread structure placement rather than only the fixed arena near the dimension origin. Previously generated arenas do not move.
config.cataclysm_dimension.reset_dimensi: After an arena is empty for 200 ticks, replay its structure. Does not delete dimension files or restore all terrain. May generate chunks in unvisited arenas.
config.cataclysm_dimension.slow_fall_whe: Give the entering entity temporary slow falling to reduce fall damage at the arrival point.
config.cataclysm_dimension.disable_respa: Disable beds and respawn anchors in arena dimension types. These devices may explode under vanilla rules; this does not disable boss respawning.
config.cataclysm_dimension.consume_telep: Consume one eye when the destination is ready and teleportation starts. Creative players do not consume eyes. Cancelled loading does not consume an eye.
config.cataclysm_dimension.allow_use_eye: Allow eye teleportation while already inside an arena dimension. The original return-rift destination is preserved.
config.cataclysm_dimension.reset_structu: When the first player returns to a previously used arena, queue a structure replay. Does not interrupt an arena occupied by another player.
config.cataclysm_dimension.enable_return: After a main boss dies, open a right-clickable rift back to the saved departure point. Does not remove existing rifts when disabled or spawn rifts for past kills.
config.cataclysm_dimension.reset_structu: Re-entry reset requires a main-boss kill; a successful replay consumes that mark. Requires reset on re-entry. Empty-arena reset is a separate setting.
config.cataclysm_dimension.pregenerate_d: After loading a world, prepare 5 x 5 entrance chunks in each arena in the background. Off by default: uses CPU, memory and disk. Generated chunks persist; does not preload every structure or keep dimensions loaded forever. Player requests take priority.
tip.cataclysm_dimension.loading: Preparing %s (%s/%s chunks). Please wait; keep the eye in hand.
tip.cataclysm_dimension.loading_cancelle: Dimension loading cancelled. No eye was consumed.
tip.cataclysm_dimension.loading_failed: The dimension could not finish loading. No eye was consumed; try again later and check the server log.
tip.cataclysm_dimension.teleport_failed: Teleportation failed. Please check the server log.
tip.cataclysm_dimension.resetting: Restoring the arena (%s/%s chunks). Please wait.
